what: a golden jackal: a real wild animal on four legs, a small slender wild dog much smaller and lighter than a wolf, with big tall pointed ears, a narrow pointed muzzle, a slim chest, long thin legs and a short bushy tail. Its coat is golden-tawny on the legs, head and flanks, with a darker grizzled saddle of black and silver hairs over its back, a cream-white throat and belly, and a black tip to its tail.
colours: golden-tawny fur, a grizzled black and silver saddle on the back, a cream-white throat and belly, a black tail tip, a black nose, amber eyes. No grey wolf colouring and no pure black fur.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing: no collar.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it darts forward in a quick low trot with one front paw lifted, its head stretched out low and forward, its mouth open showing small sharp teeth, ears up, tail held out behind.
must_show: a real small wild dog on four legs with one head, seen from the side
big pointed ears, a narrow muzzle, thin legs
golden-tawny coat with a dark grizzled saddle on its back
slight and small: lighter than any wolf
must_not_show: fox with a huge white-tipped tail

what: a grey wolf: a real wild timber wolf on four legs of ordinary size, lean and rangy, long-legged with a deep narrow chest, a long muzzle, upright ears and a full bushy tail. Its thick coat is grizzled grey, darker charcoal along the back and the top of the tail, with pale grey-white legs, throat and belly. It is hunting.
colours: grizzled mid-grey fur, a darker charcoal-grey back and tail top, pale grey-white legs, throat and belly, yellow eyes, a black nose, white teeth. No tan, no orange and no brown fur anywhere.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it stalks forward low and crouched, about to lunge, its head held lower than its shoulders and stretched forward, lips drawn back from bared white fangs, ears pricked forward, hackles raised along the neck, tail held low and straight behind.
must_show: a real wolf on four legs, seen from the side
head low, fangs bared, about to lunge
grizzled grey coat with a darker back, no brown
lean and ordinary-sized: smaller than the dire wolf alpha, not howling
must_not_show: howling with the head thrown back

what: a cave hyena of the Ice Age: a real wild animal on four legs, bigger and heavier than a spotted hyena, with a heavy body that slopes steeply down from tall, massive shoulders to short, low hindquarters. It has a big broad head with a short blunt black muzzle and huge strong jaws, small round ears, a thick neck with a short bristly dark mane running down it, and a short tail with a black brush at the tip. Its thick, coarse, shaggy winter coat is pale sandy-grey, covered all over the body and legs with round dark brown spots.
colours: pale sandy-grey shaggy fur covered in round dark brown spots, a dark brown mane, a black muzzle, dark eyes, yellowed teeth, a black-tipped tail. No stripes, no orange and no red fur anywhere.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen exactly from the side in full profile, like an animal on a coin, facing left, on four legs: it hunches forward with its tall shoulders up and its head low and thrust forward in profile, its jaws wide open showing big teeth as if cackling, its back sloping down to its short hind legs.
must_show: a real hyena on four legs with one head, seen side-on in full profile
a back that slopes steeply down from tall shoulders to low hindquarters
round dark spots all over a pale sandy-grey shaggy coat
a big blunt head with huge open jaws
heavier and shaggier than a spotted hyena of Africa
